title: How to use Blender to create fashion animation?
content:
Hey everyone! 🌟 I'm Phidias, a 3D Pattern Designer using CLO3D, and I'm super excited to dive into the world of 3D pattern design!

I was wondering if anyone could suggest some great tutorials on using Blender for fashion. I'm eager to learn how to use Blender! 🤓🙏🏻

title: Troubleshooting: Auto Fitting and Arrangement Points
content:
# Are you getting these alerts when importing your custom avatar?

![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202502/12dc15957be44852b7ec66959a774353/images/596ac93da385443299075c073c4fbd0eimage.png)

**_"Arrangement points were not fitted to the avatar. The avatar must be in a T-pose or A-pose."_**

_Or  
"_**_Fitting Suit cannot be created._**_The avatar must be in a T-Pose or A-pose"_

There can be a lot of reasons that you might see these errors. First, always best check the "Best Practice Checklist" below and see if it matches what you have so far!

**Best Practice Checklist for Importing Avatars**

  * Avatar is 1 mesh body

  * Avatar has closed geometry (no holes)

  * Avatar is 1,200-2,000 millimeters tall

  * Avatar is in an A-Pose

  * Avatar has 2 arms, 2 legs, 1 head

  * Importing a OBJ or FBX file type

  * Correct normal direction (normals facing outward)




After double checking (or not, it will be covered in the flowchart) we can move onto the flow chart.

![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202502/12dc15957be44852b7ec66959a774353/images/c39f3d2fe4514096ad22d1d1f3266a9dimage.png)

If you are stuck or end up in the "contact support" portion. Make sure to contact the software support team of the software you are using: 

  * For Marvelous Designer: <https://marvelousdesigner.com/support/contact>

  * For CLO: [https://www.clo3d.com/en/support](https://www.clo3d.com/en/support)

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Thank you! This is super helpful!
content_description: This webpage provides essential troubleshooting tips and best practices for successfully importing custom avatars while addressing common error alerts related to avatar poses and geometry.

title: Live Sync Crashing attempting to Connect UE5.5
content:
Hey guys so I followed all the steps outlined in that guide for CLO Live Sync guide using the correct versions. I'm using UE5.5, I tried multiple different versions of Clo with its corresponding plugin version installed in UE5.5, downgrading my Clo3D from the latest to 2024.1.88. I have enabled directx 11 with transparency as well as the Adobe substance Plugin in UE5.5. I'm not in simulation mode or anything. However, after opening the window in Unreal, after I click the button to link Clo and Unreal the engine crashes. The closest I got was enabling unified material before clicking the button. The plugin gets stuck on 20% then still crashes. I was wondering if anyone knows an advisable fix for this? Not sure if its an Unreal or Clo problem, I just attached my crash log. Any help would be much appreciated. Thanks.

![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202502/1883d027e3494fef8f4f74a8f0f37922/images/5ec1d4e9a90949ab8f164195cd8464c6Screenshot%202025-02-07%20104645.png)

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Hello dacrequin, we have just released LiveSync 1.1.6, which includes a bug fix for this crash issue. Please download the latest version from our version archive and let us know if the issue has been resolved: https://connect.clo-set.com/community/post/1883d027e3494fef8f4f74a8f0f37922

Comment 2: Hi dacrequin, sorry to hear that LiveSync keeps crashing. I would like to learn more about the issue you have experienced. Unfortunately it is difficult to tell the cause of the issue, so could you submit a Zendesk support ticket with the following information and a crash log file? 1. CLO version, 2. CLO LiveSync version, 3. a crash log file which can be found in your Unreal project file > Saved > Logs folder, 4. the source ZPRJ file (if possible), 5. a link to this post. Thanks!
content_description: A support forum for troubleshooting CLO Live Sync issues with Unreal Engine 5.5, where users can share experiences and seek solutions for plugin crashes and compatibility problems.
